💡 كيف تُحدَّد أسعار الوقود ونصائح لتقليل: 💡 How fuel prices are set, and tips to cut your consumption
سعر الوقود عند المحطة بشكل عام ينعكس فيه: The price of fuel at the pump generally reflects a mix of the global crude oil price, the local currency's exchange rate against the dollar, and the taxes or subsidy/price-fixing mechanisms each country sets in its own way — for the exact review mechanism and official timetable in your country, see the official body responsible for fuel pricing.
لتقليل استهلاك السيارة: حافظ على ضغط الإ: To reduce your car's consumption: keep the tyres at the correct pressure (a low-pressure tyre noticeably increases consumption), avoid sudden acceleration and braking, remove excess weight and the roof rack if you are not using it, combine several short trips into one instead of repeatedly starting the engine cold, and keep up regular maintenance of the engine and air filter — all of this affects fuel consumption more than many drivers expect.
